items.title: No magnets needed: Extreme voltage drives completely new kind of Hall effect

Over time, physicists have broadened their understanding of the Hall effect, describing quantum and anomalous versions that appear under nonclassical conditions. Recently, Rice University's Qimiao Si published a paper in Physical Review Letters describing a new variant called the fully nonequilibrium response that once again expands how physicists understand the Hall effect.
